name: Materials & Process Selection in Design
summary: Systematic choice of materials and processes using Ashby charts, performance indices, shape factors and cost and environmental criteria.

topics.name: Design-led selection strategy: translate, screen, rank, document
Performance indices for stiffness-, strength- and energy-limited design
Multiple constraints and conflicting objectives (trade-off surfaces, penalty functions)
Cost modelling of materials and processes
Hybrid materials: sandwiches, lattices and segmented structures
Eco-selection: embodied energy, carbon footprint and life-cycle assessment
Selection software and databases (e.g. Granta EduPack)
